entries.title: Wren steps forward, voice low and steady as she asks what brings him to Hearth Ember Vale.
entries.text: Wren steps forward, voice low and steady as she asks what brings him to Hearth Ember Vale. "Just passing through. Heard the hearth fires here keep a man warm even when the road's cold." Ash holds his ground, saying nothing more, simply waiting for her response.

entries.text: Ash steps forward, offering a simple greeting — here to see the market's goods and trade, and curious what brings the other. Wren, rather than answering at once, stands quietly in the stall's shade, waiting. "I'm hoping to find stories as much as goods—every market has a tale or two worth trading," Wren replies. Ash tilts their head, a faint smile forming. "Odd question, coming from someone who just stood here waiting with me. What brings you? I'm just keeping an eye on the stalls."

entries.title: Wren and Ash, each hoping to make the other's acquaintance, both venture a first attempt at conversation.
entries.text: Wren and Ash, each hoping to make the other's acquaintance, both venture a first attempt at conversation. Wren offers a topic: what does Ash hope to find at the market? Perhaps they could look together. Ash, for their part, responds on a similar thread—the idea of trading goods at the market. Wren picks up on that thread, asking directly: "Trading goods? What kind of goods do you carry?" Ash answers Wren's earlier suggestion warmly: "Aye, looking together sounds fine. I'm after good wool and maybe a sturdy blade—what catches your eye?"

entries.title: Ash gave a small nod, gesturing toward the market district. It was a quiet sort of invitation, no pressure in it — just
entries.text: Ash gave a small nod, gesturing toward the market district. It was a quiet sort of invitation, no pressure in it — just a hope that Wren might join for a walk through the stalls. Wren caught the meaning at once, and her reply carried a warmth that made the offer feel like a favor freely given. She'd be glad to keep Ash company on the way. "Sounds good! Let's see what the market has to offer." "Glad for the company. Let's walk."

entries.title: Wren asks Ash if there's anything to carry that she can help with, offering a hand.
entries.text: Wren asks Ash if there's anything to carry that she can help with, offering a hand. Appreciated. Let's see what the stalls have for us. Ash moves.

entries.title: Ash waits, watching the path ahead.
entries.text: Ash waits, watching the path ahead. "Alright, I'll keep an eye out for you. Don't wander too far." Wren moves off, following the trail.

entries.title: Wren moves, putting one foot in front of the other.
entries.text: Wren moves, putting one foot in front of the other. Ash stays where they are, waiting. The distance between them narrows as Wren keeps moving. Ash holds steady, still waiting, still watching. Wren's movement carries them forward, unhurried.
